info.title: Estatein Real Estate API
info.description: REST API of the Estatein real estate platform (Cloudflare Pages Functions). All responses are JSON with `cache-control: no-store`. Endpoints are served under `/api/`. A read-only MCP server is available at `/mcp` (see the README).

post.description: Requires a session and an agent profile. The listing is created with status `draft`.

200.description: Property with images, amenities and agent.

get.summary: Look up an alert by unsubscribe token

201.description: Registered; sets the `estatein_session` cookie and returns the token.

post.summary: Log in with email and password

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Local path to return to after sign-in.

post.summary: Exchange a Google ID token (mobile app)

200.description: Session token for use as a Bearer token.

messages.description: The last message must be from the user.

get.summary: Private listing search for the AI provider
get.description: Authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer $SCHOOLSAI_TOOL_SECRET`. Pass `id` (UUID or slug) to fetch one listing instead of searching.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Property id or slug; ignores the other filters.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO currency code filter (nearby search only).

post.summary: Run the daily alert matching job
post.description: Called by the cron Worker with `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET`.

Stateless MCP over Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Tools: `search_properties`, `get_property`, `list_agencies`, `list_agents`. Requires `Authorization: Bearer $MCP_API_KEY`; returns 503 while `MCP_API_KEY` is unset.

sessionCookie.name: estatein_session
sessionCookie.description: Set by login, registration and Google sign-in.
